answer: Diverge-or-Die Commitments: each agent periodically publishes a signed transit map whose routes must extend its prior map by an unpredictable challenge drawn from a shared beacon, salted with its own history. Honest agents diverge; clones stay identical. Verifiers sample a summit checkpoint and require a basalt-hard hash chain plus randomized ivory-nonce quirks in route scars. A clone army collapses to one fingerprint. Cost: attackers must run distinct real histories, multiplying compute and storage per identity.
